purpose: Additive learning-evidence overlay for 239 cross-disciplinary candidates; does not rewrite historical catalog or assert mastery.
caution: This pass is NOT 239 complete paper reviews, nor 239 model implementations, and NONE automatically grants empirical validity.
Source IDs R01-R30 in catalog are bibliographic source reference IDs, not R001-R110 research phase IDs: keep namespaces distinct.
A linked research report means scoped relevant evidence, not that original named theory is mastered/verified.
Research projects may investigate only measurement, toy simulation, exact source authenticity, or bounded prediction; no causal or real-time generalization inherited.
Do not confuse frozen pre-outcome Git protocol with registered report; independent rerun with new independent human experiment.
2026-10-18 R110 C0 first genuine scoring failed its frozen minimum source eligibility gate, real scored E2 = 0.
PESEN v0.1 exploration and synthetic-only frozen; no upgrade or direct personal decision tool implementation.
